findings.body: On a fix branch, stage a hand edit to a synced file, then restore its working copy to sync's expected text without resetting the index. This filter skips the file before `_held` checks its status, so doctor omits the required held-back row and can report everything healthy despite the staged edit. New evidence beyond the previous default-branch ruling is the in-place path: `_files` calls `_drift` without `also`, whereas tests/test_doctor_fix_files.py:507-522 exercises staged matching text only on the default branch with committed drift. Check staged differences before excluding matching working files, and cover this case through the real command on a fix branch.
findings.title: Not done: Doctor never overwrites a change made by hand, and leaves what needs a person as one plain step
